plain_text:
Within the Golden Radio Hour archive, Herbert Marshall is credited on 90 distinct recordings across 8 programs from 1936-06-22 through 1958-10-05. Documented roles include performer on 86 recordings and host on 4 recordings.

The strongest program connections in the current GRH holdings are A Man Called X (performer on 69 recordings; 69 distinct recordings), Lux Radio Theatre (performer on 9 recordings; 9 distinct recordings), Old Gold Comedy Theater (host on 2 recordings and performer on 2 recordings; 4 distinct recordings), Suspense (performer on 3 recordings; 3 distinct recordings), Matinee Theater (host on 2 recordings; 2 distinct recordings), CBS Radio Workshop (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording), Lum and Abner (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording), and NBC University Theater (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording).

Documented character portrayals include Ken Thurston (69 portrayals).
